description.zh: 查询的证书ID，需调用 ListAtiCertificates 接口查询目标证书信息，从应答内容中获取
description.en: The ID of the certificate to query. Call the ListAtiCertificates operation to query the target certificate information and obtain the ID from the response.

description.zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

> 若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的**RequestId**作为**ClientToken**标识。每次API请求的**RequestId**不一样。
description.en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a parameter value from your client to ensure that the value is unique among different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the **RequestId** of the API request as the **ClientToken**. The **RequestId** of each API request is different.

title.zh: 证书管理 - 证书详情（包含身份证书和服务器证书）
title.en: Certificate management - certificate details (including identity certificates and server certificates)
